verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs host an "All OpenAPI Files" page at docs.rollbar.com/openapi that links a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for api.rollbar.com, covering Item, Occurrence, Metrics and Deploy resources. The probe's 404s on conventional paths like /openapi.json only show the spec isn't at those well-known locations; they do not contradict the documented download. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads and is complete, and evidence that it covers every API resource beyond the four listed tags.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: docs.rollbar.com/openapi ("All OpenAPI Files") links this downloadable machine-readable document: {"openapi":"3.1.0","servers":[{"url":"https://api.rollbar.com"}]
